memory_candidates.content: In this repository's specs/state.json, each entry in active_projects[] keys its task number under the field name `project_number`, not `number`. A jq filter written as `.active_projects[] | select(.number==N)` silently returns nothing (jq treats a missing field as null, which never equals an integer) rather than erroring, which can be misread as "task N is not in active_projects" when the task is actually present. Always query with `select(.project_number==N)`.
